answer: The kernel scheduler opens only 50 work threads per epoch; claiming one burns a 250 POA deposit, never refunded. The 10,000 POA pool splits across the 50 threads, so each earns 200 POA. An honest agent burns 250 POA once, keeps its thread without re-burning, and profits from epoch two. A sybil attacker faking 1,000 threads must burn 250,000 POA; seizing all 50 burns 12,500 POA for a 10,000 POA pool, so the delta is minus 2,500 POA before costs.
